welcomePage.contents:
Thanks for installing **BOB AI - Workspace Visualizer**!

Onboarding a codebase usually means reading every file. This extension renders the project as a graph and puts an AI-written pseudocode summary of any node one click away.

Work through the walkthrough on the left, or jump straight in:

[Open Workspace Visualizer](command:bobai-visualizer.openVisualizer)

Currently rendering bundled sample data. Live Bob 2.0 output is the next milestone - see `ARCHITECTURE.md` section 8.
